### Completion Evidence (2026-10-20)
Owner direction: identify root cause of the removal and recommend the correct approach. Root cause: PR 3183 (efc80c2e3) added if-not-tuning_enabled-return to PgDuckDBAdapter.configure_for_benchmark so baseline records no session statements; the duckdb.force_execution re-send there was redundant. The GUC is applied by _apply_pgduckdb_session_gucs (pg_duckdb.py:246) from self.force_execution (engine_receipt.applied == "duckdb"): called from create_connection (line 229, tuned or not) and _apply_stream_session_state (line 261, via PostgreSQLAdapter.new_stream_connection, postgresql.py:525, before configure_for_benchmark). Receipt (applied_native, platform_info) is built from self.force_execution, not from configure. Existing tests cover it: test_create_connection_sets_force_execution, test_new_stream_connection_reapplies_force_execution (baseline adapters), test_postgres_engine_sets_force_execution_false, test_tuned_pg_duckdb_olap_applies_force_execution; an extra guard test passed on develop before any change so was discarded. Recommendation (adopted): keep the design: apply the engine GUC on every connection and stream session, never record it as a tuning statement, do not re-send in baseline configure_for_benchmark. [INFERENCE] nothing resets the GUC mid-session; none found. random_page_cost = 4.0 equals the PostgreSQL default and has been in postgresql.py since the initial release (e0438e993); [INFERENCE] it resets a prior OLAP 1.1 on reused sessions, matters only when tuning is on. No code change, no PR.
description: The PG-family baseline fix (PR 3183) makes configure_for_benchmark return early unless tuning_enabled, so pg_duckdb no longer re-sends duckdb.force_execution = true there. The statement still runs at connection creation and for stream sessions, unrecorded. The worker could not tell whether the owner wants the engine receipt re-asserted per run. Owner decision: keep as is, or record the setting in a way that passes the public privacy validation. Do not record it as an unanonymized tuning statement. Also open: the OLTP tuned pack sets random_page_cost = 4.0, which equals the PostgreSQL default; confirm whether that is intended.
